zh-CN.title: 空间运营者上线
items: 空间管理员可任命最多 5 位完成邮箱与手机双认证的运营者
运营者拥有统一身份标识，并可处理广场禁言与聊天记录发言

en.title: Space operators
items: Space administrators can assign up to five members with verified email and phone as operators
Operators have a consistent identity badge and can manage Square mutes and publish chat-record posts
